posts.text: Oil India discovers new natural gas reserve in Rajasthan — Oil India Limited has discovered a new natural gas-bearing zone in the Dandewala Field, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. The well reportedly recorded average gas inflow of nearly 25,000 SCMD from a depth of around 950 metres. Early estimates suggest around 75 MMSCM gas-in-place potential. highlights: • First gas discovery in the shallower Sanu Formation of Dandewala field • Could strengthen India’s domestic energy production efforts • Positive signal for Rajasthan’s hydrocarbon exploration outlook Refer : English - Oil India discovers new natural…
